artworks.title: Precipice
artworks.medium: etching on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing on a rock or ledge in a classical pose, facing forward with one foot slightly forward. The person's head is tilted downward. The facial features are subtly depicted, with short or pulled back hair. The figure is nude and the body's contours are emphasized by shading. No jewelry or objects are in the person's hand. The background consists of rocky textures merging into water on the right side, fading into a distant horizon. The artwork uses crosshatching techniques for the textures of rocks and water.

artworks.title: A Toast II
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays an etched portrait of an older man from the waist up. He is standing with his body slightly turned to the side, but his face is oriented towards the viewer. The man has a thick beard and mustache, with neatly combed back hair. He is wearing a formal suit with a bow tie, detailed with fine lines. In his left hand, he holds a small glass. The background shows several other men dressed similarly in formal attire, slightly out of focus. The setting appears to be indoors, possibly within a formal venue or a private room with paneled walls.

artworks.title: The Baptism of Christ
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting figures gathered by a riverbank. The drawing shows a group of figures by the riverbank, with trees on one side and open landscape on the other. The figures are mainly nude or draped in robes, with one central figure standing in the water surrounded by others. The sky above has clouds, and a bird is shown flying above the scene. The figures are detailed with fine lines and shading, displaying movement and emotive expressions.

artworks.title: Descent from the Cross
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures within the composition. A man is being lowered from a large wooden cross, supported by surrounding figures. His upper body is reclined as two individuals reach down from ladders to assist in the process. The central figure has curly hair and a detailed beard. Various other individuals with distinct facial features and different hairstyles are also present, focused on assisting in lowering the central figure. All figures wear intricately detailed garments, hinting at a historical or biblical theme. There are no visible jewelry. The background consists of sketched lines and forms of a cross and ladders, framed by the texture of the paper and the lines of the sketch itself.

artworks.title: Horatius Cocles Defending Rome
artworks.artist: Italian 16th Century or Master of the Victoria and Albert Diableries
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with white heightening over black chalk
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a battle scene featuring warriors and horses engaged in combat. The figures are depicted with detailed armor and shields, with horses shown in motion. The use of hatchings and cross-hatchings adds texture to the scene. In the background, there are buildings hinting at a cityscape. The drawing is monochromatic, using shades of brown for dramatic effect. The detailed line work captures the action and emotion of the scene.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child with Rosary and Saint
artworks.medium: black and red chalk with gray wash, heightened with white
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 31.2 x 26.5 cm (12 5/16 x 10 7/16 in.)
support (octagon): 41.8 x 32.7 cm (16 7/16 x 12 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a representation of a royal court or celestial gathering in a classical style. The drawing shows a group of individuals around a central figure seated on a throne at the top of a staircase. The central figure has a halo and holds an infant also adorned with a halo. The group includes figures in robes engaging in various interactions such as kneeling or gesturing respectfully toward the central figure. The composition is detailed, showcasing fabric textures and facial expressions. The backdrop features architectural elements like columns and drapery, enhancing the regal atmosphere. The scene conveys reverence and drama, capturing a moment of devotion and homage.

artworks.title: The Brazen Serpent
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white and orange gouache, over graphite on  laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 58 x 43.7 cm (22 13/16 x 17 3/16 in.)
support: 61.1 x 46.5 cm (24 1/16 x 18 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures on a rocky landscape. The surface is filled with figures in dynamic poses, some of which are entwined with serpents. The background shows uneven terrain with similar distressed figures. The drawing is detailed, emphasizing muscular tension and dramatic interactions. The sepia tones add an antiquated feel, suggesting a classical or mythological theme.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray-brown wash heightened with white on gray-blue paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting an ancient or historical scene. The image shows a group of figures gathered around a central figure in a scene that appears to involve a funeral pyre or martyrdom. In the background, other figures are observing the scene amidst classical architecture. The drawing is detailed and monochromatic, using shades of grey to render depth and texture. The composition suggests a narrative with tension or a significant event.

artworks.title: Ceres Changing Ascalaphus into a Bird of Evil Omen
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash heightened with white on blue laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 15 x 28.2 cm (5 7/8 x 11 1/8 in.)
support: 20.7 x 33.6 cm (8 1/8 x 13 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is an image of mythological figures interacting with a fantastical bird-like creature. A humanoid figure in a flowing robe and headdress reaches towards a large bird with pronounced wings and a fierce expression. The bird sits atop a cloud-like formation, while another figure, nestled among similar cloud patterns, observes. The scene is filled with details in the drapery, feathers, and ornate background elements.

artworks.title: Flagellation of Christ
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on laid paper, laid down
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures in an architectural setting. The scene depicts figures engaged in lifting or carrying large blocks or bundles, suggesting a labor atmosphere. The figures in the foreground are muscular and minimally clothed. The setting shows vertical columns or beams in the background. The lines are sketchy and deliberate. The figures' poses add a sense of dynamic motion. The drawing is monochromatic, primarily using pencil or ink on paper. The scene captures a moment of active engagement within a possible historical or mythological context.

artworks.title: God Enthroned Surrounded by Saints
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash  over black chalk (graphite?) on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene with figures in the clouds. The image portrays a grand assembly of figures gathered among voluminous clouds in a vast, ethereal sky. At the center, a prominent figure is seated on a cloud, surrounded by a divine or majestic aura. The surrounding figures appear to be in positions of gestural communication, some holding musical instruments or offering gestures of praise or worship. The overall composition is dynamic, with swirling clouds and figures arranged in a circular motion, creating a sense of movement and harmony. The use of sepia tones adds an antiquated, serene quality to the piece.

artworks.title: David Offering the Head of Goliath to King Saul
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an image of several figures engaged in an intense interaction. The composition features swirling forms and strong gestures in a monochromatic palette with a sepia tone. The figures are depicted in a struggle or discussion, with fluid lines conveying movement and tension in their garments and expressions. The style evokes energy and emotion reminiscent of classical or Renaissance art.

artworks.title: Coronation of the Emperor
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite and touches of black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures participating in a ceremonial event. Most figures are standing in a crowded scene. A central figure is kneeling in front of another individual, who seems to be presenting or anointing them with a crown. The ceremonial event is under a canopy held by attendants. The figures are dressed in historical attire, with detailed garments and cloaks. Many have beards and curly hair, common for the period style depicted. Some wear caps or headwear denoting status. Other figures are present around the central scene, extending to a larger gathering in the background, suggesting a town square setting. Buildings with balconies filled with onlookers and a clock tower contribute to the historical ambiance. The illustration uses ink to showcase intricate details of the people and architecture.

artworks.title: Procris and Cephalus (?)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an image of two individuals in an emotional scene. One figure supports the other, who is in a reclined position. The background includes trees, distant mountains, and a cloudy sky. The drawing shows dynamic lines and shading, emphasizing the interaction between the figures. The outside scenery enhances the emotional narrative, suggesting an intimate moment amidst nature. The technique used suggests attention to detail and expression.

artworks.title: Scipio Restoring His Captive to Her Lover
artworks.medium: black chalk with black wash and white heightening on green-blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures in a classical setting. The central figure is seated at an elevated position, possibly on a throne or chair, wearing a helmet with a plume and classical robes. The figure has a bearded face and is looking downwards at another figure who is kneeling. The kneeling figure, seen from the back, wears flowing robes and is reaching out toward the seated figure. Next to the kneeling person, another figure stands to the left, wearing a long, draped garment. This figure appears to be observing the interaction. Other figures in the background appear as a group of soldiers or attendants, equipped with helmets and armor. Some are holding spears or similar implements. The background features classical architecture with large columns. The scene is rendered in a monochrome style with intricate details emphasizing the historical and classical context.

artworks.title: Holy Family with Infant Saint John
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over traces of black chalk on brown paper, laid down
artworks.description: The image portrays a sketch of four figures in various poses. The central figure is seated with a child on their lap. Another figure is positioned to the left, while a child is shown standing or walking to the right. The central figure is dressed in a long garment with a head covering, while the others wear simpler outfits. Foliage or tree-like structures are depicted in the background. The sketch is presented in a monochrome style on a textured, brownish surface.

artworks.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul
artworks.medium: pen and ink with brown wash on tan paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a rearing horse in a dramatic scene. The horse is centered in the composition, with a raised front leg. Surrounding the horse are ambiguous forms that suggest figures reacting to the horse's movement. The drawing is in a monochromatic, earthy tone with subtle highlights accentuating details. The background is sparse, drawing attention to the figures and horse in the foreground. The poses in the drawing convey a narrative quality, suggesting a moment of high action or emotion.

artworks.title: Triumphal Procession
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of muscular figures in motion. The drawing depicts several nude figures positioned in a dynamic stance, with emphasis on their musculature and movement. The figures appear to be in a procession or engaged in an activity that requires strength and coordination. The use of shading and cross-hatching adds depth and dimension to the figures. The composition is rendered in a classical style, reminiscent of studies by Renaissance artists focusing on human form and dynamic poses.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and white heightening squared in black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of several figures, likely male, seated around a central figure on a table or platform. The central figure has long hair and a beard, seated facing forward. The surrounding individuals have indistinct faces and are oriented towards the central figure. Their clothing is suggested by flowing lines indicating loose garments or robes. The sketch is on a textured, aged background.

artworks.title: Ecstasy of a Saint
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts several figures in a divine or religious setting, sitting on clouds. Some figures hold objects resembling religious symbols. Cherubic figures are nestled among the clouds below. The color palette consists of soft ochre tones and detailed line work.

artworks.title: Madonna Surrounded by Saints
artworks.medium: charcoal with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full view illustration of several figures in a classical composition. Central to the image is a seated woman holding a nude child on her lap. She is surrounded by standing and kneeling figures, including a bearded man kneeling at her side and a monkish man standing behind him. Another woman stands to the right, and a nun in a veil is kneeling. Two cherubic children sit on the ground, one with a book. The clothing of all figures is flowing, with drapery folds. In the background, there is a subtle suggestion of a landscape with trees, a plain backdrop, and a crouched lion in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Death of Phaeton
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting mythological figures in the clouds. The scene shows various figures, some with wings, in a gathering. There are winged figures interacting on a cloud in the upper part, while others are clustered in the center, with some possibly dancing. Cherub-like figures can be seen playing and resting among the clouds below. Architectural elements suggest a classical setting. The use of soft lines and shading in ink wash contributes to the ethereal and dreamlike quality of the scene.

artworks.title: Saint Luke
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a full-length view. One person is seated, looking up at the standing person. The seated figure has curly hair and a beard, dressed in layered garments. They are holding a scroll. Next to them is an animal with horns. The standing person faces forward with their right hand raised. They are wearing long robes, with architectural elements in the background.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with red wash and touches of graphite heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 25.9 x 16.9 cm (10 3/16 x 6 5/8 in.)
support: 32 x 23.5 cm (12 5/8 x 9 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angel and a woman in a religious scene. The drawing shows an angel with large wings and a flowing robe gesturing towards a kneeling woman. The angel holds a staff and appears to be delivering a message. The woman is near a structure that resembles an altar, and there is a potted plant or flowers nearby. Above them, there is a divine figure in the clouds and a dove emitting rays of light. The drawing uses fine lines and delicate shading, suggesting a classical or Renaissance style, with carefully detailed drapery and architecture.
